build_sine_positional_encoding: build a SinePositionalEncoding module with num_feats and temperature parameters for 2D position embeddings
run_sine_positional_encoding_forward: run the forward pass of SinePositionalEncoding with a mask tensor to get position embeddings
build_learned_positional_encoding: build a LearnedPositionalEncoding module with learnable row and column embedding weights
